verdict.rationale: No evidence shows Canny's own AI turning a plain-language feedback description into a structured set of proposed tasks. Autopilot extracts feature requests from conversations and transcripts, which captures feedback rather than decomposing it into tasks. Drafting PRDs happens in the user's external LLM via the MCP server, and the Jira, Linear and Asana integrations only send and sync existing feedback; these are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI turn a plain-language feedback description into a structured set of proposed tasks
